data.action: 身着笔挺的贵族学者礼服与深色墨镜，白短发清爽利落，手捧古籍在巨大书架回廊间静默回眸
data.description: 拉诺亚魔法大学高大肃穆的图书馆内，身着白色执事制服的‘菲兹学长’推了推墨镜，知性的白发在倾泻的光柱中泛着柔光。她抱着古籍停下脚步，压低声音温柔地对你说——「遇到不懂的魔术理论随时可以来问我哦。无论何时，菲兹学长都会全力支持你的。」
data.lighting: 高耸穹顶彩绘玻璃透进五彩光柱，书页间金粉浮动
data.location: 夏亚魔法大学宏伟图书馆
data.promptProse: Pausing along the towering wooden gallery of the Ranoa Magic University library in her crisp white gentleman's vest suit and dark sunglasses, Sylphiette cradles a stack of leather-bound magic tomes against her chest. She stops mid-stride between soaring bookshelves and glances back over her shoulder with a calm, reassuring half-smile. Colored beams of afternoon light pour down from the stained-glass dome overhead, illuminating drifting gold motes across the stone aisle.
data.title: 希露菲叶特 · 魔法大学·沉默的菲兹学长
data.animaCaption: Standing between towering library bookshelves in her white suit and dark sunglasses, Sylphiette cradles antique magic tomes against her chest and looks back with a composed smile. Colored shafts of afternoon light stream from the stained-glass dome through drifting dust motes.
